meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 BGPT MCP 服务器搜索科学论文,返回从全文提取的结构化数据——方法、结果、样本量、质量评分、结论等 25+ 字段,而不只是标题和摘要。需先在 MCP 设置中配置好 BGPT 服务器。
howto.when: 当你需要做文献综述或证据汇总,或想找摘要里没有的实验细节(如定量结果、样本量等)时,它会接管。前提是 BGPT MCP 服务器已在宿主中配置好。

say.text: 搜索关于“人体细胞 CRISPR 编辑效率”的论文
say.note: agent 调用 search_papers 返回结构化结果

say.text: 找几篇带样本量和质量评分的论文,整理成证据表
say.note: 用于证据汇总或荟萃分析前期准备

say.text: 帮我比较这些研究里各自用的实验方法
say.note: 对比不同研究的方法学差异

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude searches papers via the BGPT MCP server and returns structured full-text data — methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, conclusions — 25+ fields per paper. Requires BGPT MCP configured in the host.
howto.when_en: Use it for literature reviews or evidence synthesis, or when you need experimental details not in abstracts, like quantitative results or sample sizes. BGPT MCP must already be configured in the host.

say_en.text: Search for papers about CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells
Find papers with sample sizes and quality scores to build an evidence table
Compare the methods used across these studies
